data_audit.final_verdict: The analyses of the Patterson function reveals a significant off-origin peak that is 69.29 % of the origin peak, indicating pseudo-translational symmetry. The chance of finding a peak of this or larger height by random in a structure without pseudo-translational symmetry is equal to 3.7939e-06. The detected translational NCS is most likely also responsible for the elevated intensity ratio. See the relevant section of the logfile for more details. The results of the L-test indicate that the intensity statistics behave as expected. No twinning is suspected.
